title: Yerevan - Oct 16, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks durinng addressing the 17th Summit of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP 17).
text:
Yerevan - Oct 16, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks durinng addressing the 17th Summit of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP 17)."

""

"------"

"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:38): "War does not only target humans and economic infrastructures; it also harms nature. It burns forests, destroys wetlands, contaminates the soil, threatens water resources, eradicates habitats, displaces animal species, and introduces chemicals and heavy metals into natural cycles. The effects of war on the environment can persist for years after the hostilities have ended.""

"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:39 - 01:29): "Today, the international community knows well that environmental destruction in armed conflicts is not a secondary or insignificant consequence of war; these damages are directly linked to the security and well-being of future generations. In our region, including Iran, the environmental impacts of military conflicts must be addressed with greater seriousness by the global community. The war and the aggressive wars waged by the United States and the Zionist regime in our region, by damaging industrial and energy facilities, causing fires, emitting pollutants, and contaminating soil and water, have threatened natural ecosystems and destroyed protective infrastructures.""

""
"SOT3, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran: "War-related damages are also issues of a global nature and require international solutions. The effects of war on ecosystems can persist for years or even generations, impacting areas many kilometers beyond the conflict zone. A clear testament to this is the scale of destruction recorded in oppressed Gaza; according to experts, parts of its soil will be unable to host life or natural ecological and botanical cycles for hundreds of years to come.""

""
"SOT4, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran: "What has occurred in our region due to aggressive wars is ecocide, which must be condemned. The international community is expected to create effective, transparent, and enforceable mechanisms to protect natural heritage and biodiversity. No country should consider nature to be a silent and defenseless victim during times of war.""

""
"SOT5, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran: "[Iran] A country that simultaneously faces pressures from climate change, drought, water scarcity, desertification, and the depletion of natural resources on one hand, and the effects of economic sanctions and limited access to technology and financial resources on the other; and which, for two consecutive years, has been the target of criminal wars involving the extensive use of destructive, prohibited weapons and, in many cases, with the deliberate aim of environmental destruction, such as attacks on fuel depots in the capital. To implement environmental programs and compensate for the damages incurred, it must benefit from genuine global cooperation.
